Name: Weapon Shipping
Author: TitanmasterRy
Description:
Ever cleared out the mines with a stack of weapons you'll never use again? Normally they'd just sit in a chest collecting dust with no way to sell them without trekking to the Adventurer's Guild. This mod fixes that. Drop any weapon into your shipping bin before you sleep and the gold will be in your account the next morning, just like selling crops.
Supports all swords, clubs, daggers, and slingshots. Prices are based on real Adventurer's Guild values at around 50% of their buy price, and modded weapons are priced automatically based on their damage stats.
You can tweak everything in the config.json that gets created on first launch, or in-game if you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed. Options include a price multiplier, a minimum sell price floor, and verbose logging for the SMAPI console.
Requires SMAPI 3.18.0 or later. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.

Source Code: https://github.com/TitanmasterRy/WeaponShipping
